handoff.claim: Aspose.3D FOSS for TypeScript: FBX is not wired into Scene.save or Scene.open (.fbx saves OBJ text, opens empty)

evidence.detail: `save` maps the extensions `obj`, `stl`, `gltf`, `glb`, `dae` and `3mf` to a format; there is no `fbx` branch, and `:312-316` falls back to the OBJ format
the exporter is chosen from five format names; `FbxFormat` reaches `throw new Error("Unsupported format: ...")` at `:360`
`openFromBuffer` detects glTF, 3MF, COLLADA and OBJ and otherwise uses `StlImporter` (`:221`); there is no FBX branch

handoff.claim: Aspose.3D FOSS for TypeScript: Scene.save to .stl writes vertex indices instead of coordinates, binary STL is 50 bytes

evidence.detail: writes `tri[0] tri[1] tri[2]`, which are polygon indices from `Mesh.polygons`, as the vertex of the facet
writes the same indices as floats into the vertex slots of the binary record

writes the header, the count and each record as separate `stream.write(Buffer)` calls, and `src/aspose/threed/Scene.ts:325` handles each Buffer write for a file path with `fs.writeFileSync(path, data)`, which replaces the file, so only the last record remains

handoff.suggested_issue_title: Aspose.3D FOSS for TypeScript: Scene.save to .stl writes vertex indices instead of coordinates, binary STL is 50 bytes
